1.  How do we stop bots from minting out too quickly?

You create a game. A very simple version of the game we are already making. This needs to be completed. When completed, only if the player holds enough in-game tokens, they are able to use them to mint an NFT.
You are NOT able to earn the token on this initial level.
Tokens will be earned later in game by those holding an NFT.

This level (random selection of at least 3 practice levels) will have to be played through before they are able to mint.*** This will be us finding out how the community feels about ***EARNING their NFTs rather than just minting them by using our “Play-To-Mint” idea

We need people to feel comfortable with both purchasing the in-game token without any liquidity AND spending this token in game. At the same time we need to find out how highly they will value the tokens they’ve earned by only allowing 1/2 of the needed tokens for the total mint to be released initially. This will be the initial liquidity for the project. The tokens earned in game, by those holding an NFT, will either be used by players in game towards their own success through the many levels, towards more mints of their own OR sold on the open market to other individuals looking to mint the second half of the NFTs.

(Solana may or may not be traded for USDC to retain the integrity of the project; this does not in any way reflect our confidence in Solana over all. Rather it highlights our foresight against any and all possible threats to the success of the project.)
3. Why do you think the initial tokens put up for sale by the project creators will be purchased and not undersold?

Simply put, we don’t. We fully expect there to be some people willing to go through all this trouble and then under sell themselves. It happens all the time. We do however expect the majority of people will find that both earning AND letting go of these tokens is a little more difficult than they’re used to.

4. Why wouldn’t you just do things like everyone else? No mint on ME. No White List. No liquidity pool for your token. It’s all very different from the current idea of how an NFT project should be run
We’ve found the current meta is broken. It seems a lot of people agree there is a problem but are benefiting from it so aren’t too keen to step up and make something different.
We are conducting a community trial. Which we have based on some of the suppositions put forth from traditional gaming.

ie: A game should seem intuitive in the manner with which it teaches you how to play. A game should be equal parts luck and skill for it to attract the largest audience. A game's currency should be earned with enough difficulty for it to be both fun and challenging. The economy should not be the main focus of the game but it should also be a key component to progression within the game.

With all of these things in mind we’ve built this game for the people. We encourage you to not think of this as a play to earn game. Rather just a very fun (and difficult) game that connects to the block chain.
5. Will there be more NFTs than just the original Florida Man and Florida Woman?
Yes. There will be more NFTs such as, but not limited to, the upgraded outfits and the items you find within the game.
YOU WILL NOT GET AN NFT EVERY ROUND. YOU MAY NOT WIN TOKENS EVERY ROUND
You will have to be lucky (and a bit skilled) while making the right choices in order to receive one of the limited number of other NFTs.

You will also need to have the proper amount of the in-game tokens in your wallet to mint this NFT within an undisclosed time limit (It will be under 5 minutes but no countdown will be on the site) or you will lose this opportunity and it will be reshuffled to another skilled and lucky player.
6. Limited number of other NFT’s? How is that sustainable long term? How will you continue the game when all of the NFTs have been collected?

We have a sink built in where you will be able to trade these NFTs back into the game for bonuses. If you make it far enough to be allowed to do so, of course. You will also be able to send you Florida Man or Florida Woman on a “camping trip” where they will be locked up for 15 days with item NFTs and they returned with the art a boost for the player in-game and the NFT is recycled. This can be done as many times as they would like.  We foresee these being recycled pretty continuously via the “camping trips”. Worst case we are coming up with new ideas for items and power-up’s all the time. So new NFTs are bound to make their way into the mix eventually.

You will start as a Florida man or a Florida woman. You are given this option at the beginning of the game. Regardless of the NFT you hold you can always choose either or.

(Unless you have sent your human on a camping trip in the swamp to burn your item NFT’s. In this case after you have connected your wallet to your account you can choose to start your run with the one of the NFTs you own.

There will be NO increased rate of receiving the item as an NFT from using a character with a burnt item attached.)

You will begin by waking up at a keg party on the beach. Your clothes are lost and You need to get off the beach before You “catch crabs” because as You move forward You find Yourself all but surrounded by them. You will have to maneuver Your way through the levels attempting to find either more items (weapons and clothing) or more money for items and survival! Along the way You will encounter many dangers and colorful characters. Just as in reality though, there are NO extra lives and there are NO save points. Which means : When You die You will restart from the beginning with NO power-ups or tools. The only thing that will make it through to Your next life is SOME of Your tokens..
Only 30%-60% of earned tokens will be transferred to the next life. On random.

As players make their way off the beach and through 5 levels of enemies. Each with a prize at the end for the player. Nothing is earned or dropped by enemies mid level until after the 3rd boss. Enemies then have a 10% chance of dropping a burger when they die giving you 5% health.

At the end of each level they will be rewarded depending on which door they chose previously. At the end of each level players will be given the option of 3 doors giving them a 33.33% chance of choosing a level that will end with the prize of a special tool, an outfit, or a random amount of coin between .7 original mint and the full mint. (amount of token given on a 30 sided die roll. Will always round down for any decimals)

The choices will be located in a different spot every time. If you are given an item and decide not to use it you will get to burn the item for coin. (MEEK and COMMOM - .25 original mint price, NEFARIOUS and INFAMOUS - .5, SUPERHERO - .75)

Luck based. No label on the door

(Ads on the first 3 levels across the bottom of the screen. Will not affect game play or be overly distracting. They will all be tech based but we will be reaching out to crypto projects (Tokens and NFTs across all chains) to advertise for them as well. The goal eventually being to have mostly crypto projects advertising. Making us a go-to for all new and up and coming projects looking to be seen)

After beating 4 levels (Not including a boss) you will meet A Moonshiner at the start of every 5th level (unless that level is a Boss level in which case it will defer to the level after the Boss fight) who will offer you some moonshine in exchange for 2x the original mint price and 3 on-chain tokens to go from Meek to Common,  3x the original mint price and 4 on-chain tokens for Common to Nefarious,  4x the original mint price and 5 on-chain tokens for Nefarious to Infamous. 5x the original mint price and 7 on-chain tokens for Infamous to Superhero. This will upgrade your outfit and its abilities to the next available level. Unless the ability has reached its cap. In which case, he WILL still offer it to you. If you choose to accept he will begin to hand it to you and then pull back ONE time.
“Mmmm I’m not so sure you need any more of this! And coming from me that's really saying something! Hahaha!!”

You will then be given the option to spend the coin anyway or to leave the conversation. If you spend the coin on an upgrade when you've reached the peak of that particular outfit you will get sick and gain nothing while losing the coin you spent.

When the abilities level cap has been reached. If A Moonshiner is found and the coin is spent then you have a 25% chance of going down 1 level. (20% with max luck stat) 74.95% chance of just getting too drunk and blacking out. (74.8% with max luck stat) 0.05% chance of getting Superhero level upgrade of a different ability. (.1% with luck stat)

When players are about to go into a boss level they will be only given one door which will be a rectangle of light instead. Once you've reached this point you will meet A Retailer Person because you've now just stumbled into a store. You can purchase health from A Retailer Person directly. The amount of health will range from 20% - 80% increase with only 1 health available for purchase per visit.
With 30% health buff and below ONLY

You will have a 70% chance of being allowed to double the health buff before you purchase it for the first time and then after you purchase it the first time you only have a 30% chance of being allowed the second time you get a health buff 30% and below. Then after the second time you use it you have a 50% chance of being allowed. After the third time you use it you have a 20% chance of being allowed. after the fourth time you use it you have a 70% chance of being allowed. After the fifth time you use it you will have a 10% chance of being allowed. After the sixth time that you use it you will have an 80% chance of being allowed. Then it will start over at step two allowing you 30% of the time and repeating the cycle through to the sixth time of an 80% chance of being allowed and continuing that cycle until we feel it is broken
Of course This will be a second fee of very slightly more coin. If you do NOT get the double health buff it will stay at the same % until you do.
%’s only change when you succeed at getting the double health buff.
There will also be an arrangement of 4 items in the store after A Retail Person you can choose from next and purchase if you wish to and have enough coin.

Next to these items is A Shady Character who is willing to “find some more things in the back” for (3x the mint price of the original) coins. Meaning you will get a new selection of items to choose from and this can be done with or without purchasing from the selection of items given to you previously and can be done as many times as one can afford. The selection of items will be only Common or Nefarious (equal % chance of any item in those fields. Maximum 40% Common 60% Nefarious with max luck stat) at the first shop. Then Nefarious and Infamous will be added for the second shop.(40% chance of any item Common, 40% chance of any item Nefarious, 20% chance of Infamous. With max luck stat 35% chance of any item Common, 35% chance of any item Nefarious, 30% chance of Infamous)

If you defeat 3 bosses you are given the option to remove some of your tokens from the game and send them to your main wallet (for a fee of 1 token) with a maximum of 3x what the mint price will be of the original mint per withdrawal. you will have a 30% chance (may be adjusted) of being allowed to mint ONE of your items as an NFT (NEFARIOUS (fee of 3x original mint), INFAMOUS (fee of 4x original mint), or SUPERHERO (fee of 5x original mint) instead of withdrawing the tokens if you have enough SOL and withdrawn tokens to mint. The tokens used for minting need to be on the blockchain.
MEEK AND COMMON ITEMS WILL NOT BE MINTED AS NFTs.
you will not lose the item in game by minting the NFT.

After You have some interactions with different people in the world, they may take a liking to You, and may agree to come to Your next beach party. Can You elude all of the Florida madness, find your clothes, get your keys back, pay your rent on time and save the sea turtles!?

3. Why do you think the initial tokens <REDACTED> not undersold?
		Simply put, we don’t. We fully expect there to be some people willing to go through all this trouble and then under sell themselves. It happens all the time. We do however expect the majority of people will find that both earning AND letting go of these tokens is a little more difficult than they’re used to.
4. Why wouldn’t you just do things like everyone else? No mint on ME. No White List. No liquidity pool for your token. It’s all very different from the current idea of how an NFT project should be run..
		We’ve found the current meta is broken. It seems a lot of people agree there is a problem but are benefiting from it so aren’t too keen to step up and make something different. 
We are conducting a community trial. Which we have based on some of the suppositions put forth from traditional gaming. 
	ie: A game should seem intuitive in the manner with which it teaches you how to play. A game should be equal parts luck and skill for it to attract the largest audience. A game's currency should be earned with enough difficulty for it to be both fun and challenging. The economy should not be the main focus of the game but it should also be a key component to progression within the game. 	
	With all of these things in mind we’ve built this game for the people. We encourage you to not think of this as a play to earn game. Rather just a very fun (and difficult) game that connects to the block chain.
5. Will there be more NFTs than just the original Florida Man and Florida Woman?
	Yes. There will be more NFTs such as <REDACTED> the upgraded outfits and the items you find within the game.
	 YOU WILL NOT GET AN NFT EVERY ROUND. YOU MAY NOT WIN TOKENS EVERY ROUND
You will have to be lucky (and a bit skilled) while making the right choices in order to receive one of the limited number of other NFTs.
 You will also need to have <REDACTED> or you will lose this opportunity and it will be reshuffled to another skilled and lucky player.
6. Limited number of other NFT’s? How is that sustainable long term? How will you continue the game when all of the NFTs have been collected?
	We have a sink built in where you will be able to trade these NFTs back into the game for bonuses. If you make it far enough to be allowed to do so, of course. We foresee these being recycled relatively early, long before someone collects one of each. Worst case we are coming up with new ideas for items and power-up’s all the time. So new NFTs are bound to make their way into the mix eventually..
